reden: Yes. The report explicitly flags in SecondSwap_StepVesting.transferVesting that releaseRate is recomputed as totalAmount/numOfSteps, ignoring amountClaimed and stepsClaimed, and explains that claimable() overpays for non-final steps, enabling sellers to over-claim and make the vesting pool insolvent. It provides matching attack paths and impacts, and implicitly the same fix (use (totalAmount - amountClaimed)/(numOfSteps - stepsClaimed)). This is the same function, mechanism, and exploit as the vulnerability description.
